programme.desc: Stan og Kyle prøver å forhindre at Wall-Mart forvandler South Park til en spøkelsesby, men en besatt Cartman står i deres vei.

programme.title: South Park: Bestevenner for alltid
programme.desc: Cartmans blir sjalu når Kenny får det siste nye bærbare spillet før lekebutikkene går tomme. Vil Cartman og Kenny kunne forbli bestevenner for alltid?

programme.title: South Park: Se opp for de selvgode!
programme.desc: South Parks innbyggere kjøper hybridbiler, men idet folk begynner å føle seg fornøyde fordi de redder verden, samler en mørk sky seg over byen.

programme.title: South Park: Kjærlighet, ikke Warcraft
programme.desc: Guttene har spilt World of Warcraft en hel helg da en annen spiller dreper dem uten tegn på anger.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med toeren på pissoaret
programme.desc: Cartman tror han vet hvem som står bak angrepene 11. september.

programme.title: South Park: Heia Gud
programme.desc: Cartman prøver å reise til fremtiden for å kjøpe et nytt dataspill.

programme.title: South Park: Heia Gud XII
programme.desc: Cartman fryser seg ned og våkner opp 500 år inn i fremtiden.

programme.title: South Park: Lusningen
programme.desc: Cartman vil finne kilden til et luseutbrudd på skolen, så han kan gjøre narr av ham.

programme.title: South Park: De levende hjemløses natt
programme.desc: Uteliggere oversvømmer South Park, og guttene legger en lur plan for å flytte dem til en annen by, mens de voksne får panikk.

programme.title: South Park: Hyllusinasjoner
programme.desc: De hysteriske foreldrene i South Park får enda en grunn til panikk når 'cheesing' blir poplært blant barna.

programme.title: South Park: Utlogget
programme.desc: Forvirring og panikk råder da Internett blir borte i South Park!

programme.title: South Park: Pandemien
programme.desc: South Park tar en 'Cloverfield' med store, mystiske skapninger som herjer rundt i verden og blir fanget opp av Randys kamera.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemien 2: Alarmerende
programme.desc: Enorme marsvin angriper byer i hele verden. Guttene har nøkkelen til å redde menneskeheten, men sitter fast i Andesfjellene.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Kaptein Tjukkskjegg
programme.desc: Cartman har hørt om alle de rikdommene som blir plyndret av pirater i Somalia, så han setter en lapp over øyet og sleper gjengen med til Afrika for å få en bit av kaka.

programme.title: South Park: Tiss
programme.desc: Høyt urininnhold i svømmebassenget fører til en katastrofe som ødelegger guttas dag, særlig Kyles. Og Cartmans xenofobi får fritt utløp igjen.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Etterpåklokskap
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbake og denne gangen har han venner!

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reiser seg
programme.desc: Ført an av 'Mysterion', jobber 'Coon' og vennene hans med å hjelpe folk i Gulfen. Og 'Coon' er ute etter hevn.

programme.title: South Park: Coon mot Coon og venner
programme.desc: 'The Coon' viser seg å være enda ondere en den mørke mesteren Cthulhu, når han krever hevn over sine tidligere partnere.

programme.title: South Park: Lattermaskinen
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt gjort narr av på The South Park Elementary Comedy Awards, bygger Germany en uovervinnerlig lattermaskin: Funnybot. Men dens planer for menneskeheten går likevel ikke altfor bra.

programme.title: South Park: Vulkanen
programme.desc: Guttene drar på jakt med Stans gale onkel Jimbo, uvitende om at fjellet de er på er en vulkan på nippet til å bryte ut.

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans bestefar prøver å lure guttene til å drepe ham. Foreldrene i South Park prøver å få stanset sendingene av 'Terrance and Phillip'.

programme.title: South Park: Øyekatarr
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny blir drept av en styrtende romstasjon og forvandlet til en zombie, ved hjelp av balsameringsvæske og Worcestersaus.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park begynner å eksplodere uten forvarsel. Stans far tar saken.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny blir oppslukt av det siste nye fra Japan: Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Datakalenderen
programme.desc: Cartman skryter av sin nye Trapper Keeper, men en fremmed forteller ham at den snart vil ta over verden om de ikke ødelegger den nå.

programme.title: South Park: Det helsprø antastningseventyret
programme.desc: Kyle ringer politiet for å si at foreldrene har forgrepet seg på ham. Snart har alle barna anmeldt foreldrene, til det bare er barn igjen i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Helvete bryter løs
programme.desc: 'Du vet hva' er løs da innbyggerne i South Park hører banning i en populær TV-serie.

programme.title: South Park: Towelie
programme.desc: Guttene er oppslukt av Stans nye spillkonsoll. Mens de spiller, begynner håndkledet Towelie å snakke til dem.

programme.title: South Park: Professor Kaos
programme.desc: Gutta gir Butters sparken som venn og vekker hans mørke side.

programme.title: South Park: Kidnapping er ikke gøy
programme.desc: Etter å ha sett for mye på TV blir Tweek overbevist om at barn ikke er trygge og at han kommer til å bli kidnappet.

programme.title: South Park: Grått daggry
programme.desc: Pensjonistene mister førerkortene etter å ha skapt kaos i gatene. Stans bestefar søker hjelp hos pensjonistforeningen AARP.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Mannskapet trekker jadesteiner opp av J-linsen, men en stort problem på veien setter alt i fare.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Når Claudia og Robin ikke finner jade under prøveboringen klarer selv ikke firmaets geologer enes om en plan.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia, Robin og mannskapet sliter med å frakte tungt utstyr opp et fjell før stigende vannivå i elver gjør det umulig å nå gruveområdet.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Stemingen forverres når mannskapet sliter med å frakte tungt utstyr opp en vanskelig og gjørmete 120 km lang vei for å grave ut en ny jadegruve på et fjell.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Mannskapet prøver å frakte maskinene over stigende elver for å grave ut den nye fjellgruven.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alan er overbevist om at det er jade under en vanngrop på Dynasty-området deres.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Robin forsøker å trosse fysiske lover ved å sette opp en massiv sovebrakke i deres selverklærte Wolverine-område.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Flere uhell rammer Jade-mannskapet, og alle kommer opp med sine egne løsninger for å jage vekk demonene.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alle blir begeistret når de endelig graver opp grønne kampesteiner som kan være verdt millioner.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spenningsnivået øker da de utenlandske investorene plutselig stikker innom for å sjekke Wolverine-gruven. Alan forsøker å skape fred.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Etter endelig å ha oppdaget flere lovende steiner i Wolverine-gruven, oppdager mannskapet at de kanskje har gått ut forbi sitt erklærte område.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Spenningsnivået stiger når slutten av gruvesesongen nærmer seg, og Jade-mannskapet er redde for å ikke finne den etterlengtede steinen verdt millioner.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Kuldegrader utfordrer Jade-gruvearbeiderne som forsøker å treffe jackpotten – en jadestein stor nok til å imponere investorene – før gruvesesongen er over.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia og Robins uprøvde maskiner bryter sammen på den tøffe veien opp til Wolverine-gruven.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Mannskapet forsøker å krysse stigende elver mens de frakter maskinene opp til gruven, men Josh blir hengende etter med sin trøblete gravemaskin.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Josh er strandet på den lange veien til Wolverine-gruven da bolter faller av gravemaskinen, og han ikke kan be om hjelp.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Gruvesesongen begynner. Mens jade er vanskelig å finne blir et transportuhell til hell for byen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Guy blir satt til å lede Wolverine, der introduksjonen av en ny arbeider truer med å ødelegge oppdraget om å finne sesongens første jade.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Akkurat når Wolverine-mannskapet forbedrer sikkerhetsprosedyrene, kollapser den nye arbeideren Jay, og avslører mangler i nødhjelpsberedskapen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Josh er strandet med den nye gravemaskinen mens en rekke verdiløse steiner får Claudia til å vurdere en ny gruvestrategi.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Alan tar med en gruppe kjøpere til Jade, og presser Claudias team til å finne de første salgbare jadesteinene for sesongen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Mens mannskapet sliter seg gjennom gjørme for å finne en millionstein, risikerer Josh å miste utstyr verdt en halv million dollar ved å prøve å dra lastebilen ut av et synkehull.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Teamet finner sesongens beste jadestein, men risikerer å ødelegge verdien når de prøver å tette igjen alle sprekkene.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias sønn Justin viser at han har et øye for jade, mens Scrappy Larry, Robin og Josh forsøker å slepe den ødelagte lastebilen langs veien til Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Flere skuffelser tvinger Robin og Justin på et siste desperat søk etter jadesteiner for å redde sesongen mens Scrappy Larry haster med å konvertere en dieseltank.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudias forsøk på å huse en arbeidsgruppe i Jade trues når septiktanken faller i drikkevannet.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Med tidlig kulde og økende gjeld drar mannskapet i land en gigantisk, potensielt sesongreddende jadestein.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Årets mest lovende stein er under sagene på Wolverine i det Josh og R2 krasjer lastebilen deres. Claudia og mannskapet er rystet.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Kampen mot klokken er i gang for å komme seg ut av Wolverine-leiren før snøen begraver alt.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia blir tvunget til å kjøre steintrucken mens mannskapet sliter seg opp den tøffe veien til fjellgruven i Wolverine.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Stemningen når bristepunktet når Claudia, Robin og mannskapet forsøker å transportere folk og utstyr til den avsidesliggende jadeleiren.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Claudia og Robin prøver å imponere sine nye forretningspartnere, men de første dagene på den nye plassen, Bullion Creek, er frustrerende.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Sesongens første store stein fraktes tilbake til leiren og legges under sagen.

programme.title: Jade Fever
programme.desc: Justin gjør et krav etter et omfattende jadefunn, men andre gruvearbeidere nærmer seg stadig.

programme.title: Matlock: The Trial (Part 1)
programme.desc: When an Assistant District Attorney is murdered, Matlock is asked to switch sides and act as Special Prosecutor for the state of Georgia.

programme.title: Matlock: The Trial (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock’s investigation as the state’s Special Prosecutor uncovers a judicial conspiracy involving two judges and a corporate lawyer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Accident
programme.desc: Matlock’s client is accused of killing his ambulance-chasing lawyer who specializes in cases of personal injury – especially when the injuries occur at a local amusement park.

programme.title: Matlock: The Celebrity
programme.desc: Ben Matlock flies out to Hollywood to defend a beautiful former actress, Catherine Welden, who formed a lucrative cosmetic business only to be accused of murdering an ex-lover who was blackmailing her.

programme.title: Matlock: The Witness Killings (Part 1)
programme.desc: When Matlock returns to his hometown, he ends up defending an accused murderer and becoming the town’s worst enemy.

programme.title: Matlock: The Witness Killings (Part 2)
programme.desc: When Matlock returns to his hometown, he ends up defending an accused murderer and becoming the town’s worst enemy.

programme.title: Matlock: The Strangler
programme.desc: Matlock’s personal accountant seeks representation by Ben when he is framed for the brutal murder of his employer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Nightmare
programme.desc: A vacation to a wild west ghost town becomes more than Matlock bargained for as a bump on the head takes him straight back in time to the real old wild west, surrounded by familiar faces – with very unfamiliar occupations.

programme.title: Matlock: The Marriage Counselor
programme.desc: Matlock’s dull, droning insurance broker, Allan Corning finds therapy for his struggling marriage interrupted by the sudden murder of his therapist, Dr. Harding Fletcher.

programme.title: Matlock: The Dame
programme.desc: When Matlock is slapped by an attractive older woman in a restaurant, Ben recalls to Julie the story of his first case – the murder of the man who put him through law school.

programme.title: Matlock: The Suspect (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.

programme.title: Matlock: The Suspect (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the aid of a young socialite accused of murdering her older husband for money.

programme.title: Matlock: The Defense
programme.desc: After witnessing a violent argument between his parents, a distraught young man murders his abusive father.

programme.title: Matlock: The Game Show
programme.desc: Matlock comes to the defense of popular game show host Dennis Blake who’s accused of the murder of his successful, yet despised mega-millionaire producer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Foursome
programme.desc: A brash multimillionaire, Ellis Blake is held in the slaying of Jeffrey Holden, a handsome, young man who intended to marry Ellis’ daughter – without his blessing or consent.

programme.title: Matlock: The Picture (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock’s search for evidence to prove his client innocent of killing her husband uncovers a ring of counterfeiters who will pay any price, including murder, to keep their secret. Ben’s investigation uncovers ties to the mob.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock’s faith in his ability as a top-notch attorney is completely eroded when he’s dismissed by a client and replaced by a younger lawyer.

programme.title: Matlock: The Outcast (Part 2)
programme.desc: During his fishing trip, Matlock encounters the small, unfriendly town of Lone Pine as he attempts to solve the mysterious death of a young farmhand and uncover a town-wide coverup.

programme.title: South Park: Kravene heves
programme.desc: Cartman innrømmer endelig at han er feit og får umiddelbart en permobil.

programme.title: South Park: Hobbiten
programme.desc: Wendy prøver å pare en av sine venninner med Butters, men hun ender opp på kontoret til skolekuratoren.

programme.title: South Park: #Oppkok
programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spill med lillebroren sin. Men da Ike vil ikke spille med ham mer, blir Kyle redd for at neste generasjon vil forbigå ham.

programme.title: South Park: Glade hologram
programme.desc: Cartman trender, mens resten av USA forbereder seg til det største juleprogrammet på tv noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Fabuløs og modig
programme.desc: Gutta viser Caitlyn Jenner sin enormt store respekt i det mest fabuløse og modige 'South Park'-avsnittet noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Trygt sted
programme.desc: Cartman er siste offer innen kroppsskam.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Den nye gutten i klassen overtaler Jesus til å kjempe mot Satan, i det endelige oppgjøret mellom godt og ondt. Cartman blir rasende når han oppdager at oppgjøret krasjer med bursdagsfesten hans.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans mor er en hore
programme.desc: Dr. Mephisto hjelper Cartman med å avsløre farens identitet, og alle mannlige innbyggere i South Park er aktuelle kandidater.

programme.title: South Park: Byen ved avgrunnens rand (tilbakeblikk)
programme.desc: Skolebussen krasjer i en snøstorm og blir stående på kanten av et stup.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny blir oppslukt av det siste nye fra Japan: Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer nabolaget
programme.desc: Token føler seg ensom fordi han er eneste rike barn i byen, og lokker andre velstående mennesker til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmtraileren
programme.desc: Alle barna i South Park er superspente på å se den første traileren for den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmen.

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Jimmy og Timmy blir medlemmer av gjengen The Crips, som de tror er en klubb for funksjonshemmede.

programme.title: South Park: Feitrumpe og pannekakehode
programme.desc: Cartman lager en J-Lo-fingerdukke til et arrangement som skal hylle latinamerikanere.

programme.title: South Park: Dum, bortskjemt hore-leketøy
programme.desc: Paris Hilton åpner butikk i South Park og forderver jentenes moral - bare Wendy holder fast på sine prinsipper.

programme.title: South Park: Agentbyrået
programme.desc: Som talentmanagere kan Cartman, Stan og Kenny innkassere 10 % av klientenes inntekter, men et annet byrå stjeler deres eneste klient.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Psychic Larges
programme.desc: Endelig frenes Mike med samboerne. Guido-ene finner ut hva familien har i vente med hjelp av et medium.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Single J-Woww
programme.desc: J-Woww bli offisielt skilt og det er på tide å feire det på storslått måte. Mike renvasker seg fra all møkka om hans tid på college.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Chicken Cutlets and Ketchup
programme.desc: Vinnys mor Paola, forbereder en storslått italiensk fest for Mike, og onkel Nino blir med. Samtidig inviterer Angelina en uventet gjest til baren.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Shorefather
programme.desc: Det er premierekveld for Guidos-ene da de ser en film de har laget for å hedre Mike. De klaemmer åtte måneder inn i en kveld og gjenskaper hva Mike gikk glipp av da han satt inne.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Prenups and Misdemeanors
programme.desc: Gjengen trenger GTL. Angelina trenger en særeie-advokat. Jenni og Nicole trenger en spade - for å grave opp beviset med.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Unresolved Issues
programme.desc: Det er tid for utdrikningsfest og jentene drar til New Orleans for å feire Angelina. Men uløste problemer truer med å ødelegge hele greia.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Crash the Bachelorette
programme.desc: Jenni og Angelina renser luften. Og operasjon 'knus utdrikningslaget' får full effekt når Mike, Vinny og Pauly klekker en plan for å overta jentenes helg i New Orleans.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Beignets, Blow Up Dolls and Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Jenny står i spissen for Vinny. Er det en fugl, et fly eller The Designation?
programme.sub-title: Beignets, Blow Up Dolls and Bridesmaids

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: P-WOWW
programme.desc: Angelinas utdrikningsfest er overtatt av gutta og begynner med strippeklubben og slutter med at Pauly og Jenny ligger i samme seng.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: So That Happened!
programme.desc: Nedtellingen til Angelinas bryllup begynner. Mike avanserer og Pauly D og Jenni ville natt får samboerne til å stille mange spørsmål.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Rewriting History
programme.desc: Angelinas bryllup er like rundt hjørnet så gjengen feirer henne med en tur til Jersey Shore.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: You Had Me At Um, Hello!
programme.desc: Den store dagen er endelig her! Jenni føler seg forhekset, Angelina velsignet og Mike litt oransje.
programme.sub-title: You Had Me At Um, Hello!

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Speech Part 1
programme.desc: Angelina og Chris gifter seg. Vinny protesterer og jentenes tale til bruden leder til buing i Staten Island-stil.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Speech Part 2
programme.desc: Angelinas bryllupsfest blir kaotisk når Deena, Jenni og Nicole holder tale. Jentene blir forskrekket, Angelina raser og guttene prøver å gjøre det godt igjen. Men skaden er kanskje allerede gjort.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Mediation
programme.desc: To dager etter Angelinas bryllup, er jentene helt på tuppa over talen som ble hørt verden rundt. Og Mike "The Situation" blir megler i håp om å føre familien sammen igjen.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Taken Pauly
programme.desc: Midt oppi en global pandemi, fortsetter jentene med sosial distansering, men ikke på grunn av covid-19. Pauly er full av overraskelser når samboerne får vite at han ikke sitter i karantene alene.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: The Double Book
programme.desc: Desperate tider krever desperate tiltak og gutta er klare for en familieferie. R, S, V og P har en sniken overraskelse for å få jentene sammen igjen, men Deena har en egen overraskelse som kan komplisere alt.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Single Ronnie
programme.desc: Nedtellingen til Angelina kommer er i gang, og gutta må finne ut hvordan de skal presentere nyheten for Deena. Samtidig prøver gjengen å spille Kirsten giftekniv ved å lage et datingprogram til singel-Ronnie.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Trouble Shot At Love
programme.desc: Datingprogram-ekspertene DJ Pauly D og Vinny Guadagnino er programledere. Seks jenter konkurrerer om den ultimate ungkarens kjærlighet, Ronnie Magro, i det splitter nye datingprogrammet "A trouble shot at love."

programme.title: Jersey Shore Family Vacation: Jurrasic Angelina
programme.desc: Dobbeltbokingen blir full av følelser da Angelina slår ned i Las Vegas-sjøen. Deena blir på tuppa når hun kommer og Vinny dukker for slagene og The Situation blir overveldet.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Mediterranean and North Africa
programme.desc: Italy's failed attacks in the Mediterranean region draw in the Germans.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Turning the Tide
programme.desc: Allies turn the tide in the Atlantic, where initially German U-Boats harass freely convoys to supply Britain. The route to bring American soldiers who will land on D-Day is clear.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.
programme.sub-title: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler

programme.title: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programme.desc: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.
programme.sub-title: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: Mata Hari. Dance, Seduction and Espionage. The enduring myth.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”, the biggest aircraft in WWII.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive in Rio and excitedly explore the luxurious villa they will be staying in. On a rare day off, they are driven to Ipanema to play beach volleyball with local guys, and in the evening, they are joined for dinner by Lisa.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The top three girls take a cable car to Sugar Loaf Mountain to learn Samba dancing.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Aptitude and Natural Talent
programme.desc: All 14 girls are interviewed by the press where they are asked why they want to win. The models pair up and pick each partners best and worst features. The girls receive news about their first photoshoot and later find out it's a topless shoot in pairs.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Poise and Composure
programme.desc: The girls get a crash course in dance with top choreographer Supple and a runway lesson from top fashionista Jeanette. The winners get to take part in a fashion show featuring the work of top designer Scottee - whose dresses are all made out of paper.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Style and Presentation
programme.desc: The girls find out they're getting makeovers in a Lisa Mail. This weeks challenge is a bucking bronco advertisement for the cheesy "Britain's Next Top Model Hairspray". In this weeks photoshoot they have the added element of working with a small dog.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Character and Personality
programme.desc: The girls took part in a challenge for Jai Kudo glasses. At the photoshoot the models are greeted by Gerry Deveaux and Giorgio Guidotti, of Italian fashion house, Primarni for a shoot for the latest collection by SportMax one of Max Mara's labels.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Exhibition and Spectacle
programme.desc: The girls meet with TV star, June Sarpong to learn interview skills and are judged by undercover magazine journalists. The claws are out as the girls critique each other during the challenge. Tension in the house builds.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Drama and Performance
programme.desc: This week the girls learn some new choreography with Supple and in the photoshoot the girls are told they are to pose for an album cover. Lisa Snowdon treats everyone to cocktails with The Bar Wizards -finalists on last years Britain's Got Talent.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Intelligence and Originality
programme.desc: The models face an acting challenge which includes a steamy kissing scene with guest actor Guy Burnet. The photoshoot this week is a couture shot where each girl had to portray a different emotion.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Imagination and Creativity
programme.desc: The girls pose as different types of mannequines for their photoshoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Stamina and Endurance
programme.desc: The girls are put through a series of circus acts and asked to model on plinths in London's streets. The girls also pose for beauty shots in Zandra Rhodes dresses in the style of sporting events.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Beauty and Cover Girl
programme.desc: The girls start the week by attending a casting session with Sadie Frost and Jemima French. They meet up with Caroline Barnes and Sophie Beresiner for a beauty editorial and the photoshoot is for the cover of Company Magazine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Semi-Finals
programme.desc: In the penulimate episode of Cycle 4, the girls arive in South Africa and they participate in an African themed photoshoot. In the end one girl is sent home to the UK.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Finals
programme.desc: In the finale the girls do one last photoshoot with animals in the South African bush. Then, after one girl is eliminated, the girls participate in an African runway show and 'Britain's Next Top Model' is crowned.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The contestants arrive at the house with a champagne reception greeted by host Lisa. They complete an assault course and a catwalk challenge featuring clothing by Ed Hardy. The photo challenge sees the remaining girls in an army inspired shoot with Huggy.
programme.sub-title: The Girls Go To Boot Camp

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: This weeks challenge is to film an advert on the Millennium bridge wearing Elizabeth Emanuel bridal wear. The photoshoot challenge asks the girls to pose naked in a bath of water filled with mangos for Simple Cosmetics.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls excitedly receive their long awaited makeovers. The challenge involves the girls performing a dance routine in groups of four at London's Movida nightclub.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls meet 'rock royalty' Jo Wood who challenges them to inspire teenagers. They're interviewed by Johnny Vaughan at Capital FM and the photo shoot has the girls posing for adverts highlighting issues raised by charities and campaigns

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1963 corvette and a 1931 Model A hot rod. The corvette has to be ready in time for a wedding in less than two months. The hot rod has been torn to pieces by a well-intentioned internet mechanic.
programme.sub-title: 1963 Corvette, 1931 Ford Model A Hot Rod

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: For years, Rich and Kathy tried to get their 1951 Buick Super back on the road. It’s now up to FantomWorks to succeed where four other shops failed. Dan has to solve the mystery of Jim’s classic 1961 Corvette and determine if the car needs major surgery.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Larry wants to drive his1959 Cadillac DeVille, but the car has spent decades baking in the Arizona sun. Brian spent years gathering parts to restore his grandfather’s 1960 Bel Air only to find that he’s missing more critical components than he’s found…

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Bill needs Dan to tame a 1969 Pontiac Firebird that was set-up for just one thing – speed. Tim’s 1974 International Harvester Scout was given a paint job that took 4 years. He hopes that Dan can somehow pick up the pieces. Literally.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Arthur bought his Cyclone new in 1967. Then, his father put 400,000 miles on it. Now, he wants FantomWorks to make it better than new. Antonio and his cousin Andres challenge Dan to build the fastest Mustang CS in Mexico.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Chris wants the 1950 F1 Truck he remembers from high school and Dean wants the 1968 Lincoln Continental he drove with his dad.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: David and Chuck want their family heirloom 1961 International Harvester Metro Van converted into a state-of-the-art restomod, with all the trimmings. David asks Dan to find and restore a very specific car he’s always wanted: a 1966 Lincoln Convertible.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Sean asks Dan to find a 1969 Camaro that can be built into the custom restomod of his dreams. Jeff wants to give his 1969 Cutlass a rare Hurst makeover, but the engine has never run and there are more parts in boxes than on the car.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Bo put his 1970 Corvette into storage thirty years ago. Dan discovers that the car needs repair of decades old vandalism. Steve’s 1964 GTO was smashed in an accident. Dan agrees to try and bring his mangled GTO back from beyond the grave.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Jerry shows up with a car in pieces, a U-Haul full of parts and a dream of a perfect Plymouth Business Coupe that desperately needs Dan’s help. Bill asks Dan to find him a 1972 Gran Sport and to restore it with hard-to-find features.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Kansas City Royals pitcher Tim Collins wants a ‘super-fast’ 1968 Mustang, but Dan has to first undo a nightmare combination of bad repairs and unsafe systems. Bob needs a FantomWorks reality check to get his beloved 1950 Willy’s Jeep back on the road.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Charles wants Dan to find him a 1967 Corvette with a set-up that’s rare as hen’s teeth. Bob’s 1973 Cuda has been stored for most of its life – but even in storage time takes a heavy toll.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Emmett believes his 1964 Barracuda is all original. But Dan finds out that the car has hidden damage and a past that nobody expected. Velvet wants Dan to get her 1953 Studebaker Commander running as a surprise for her husband, Travis.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Walter loves the fast and futuristic look of his 1975 Bricklin. Unfortunately, the car drives like something from the dark ages. Dan restores a 1963 Split Window Corvette for a pair of owners who know him well – his Uncle Carl and Aunt Claire.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The black 1978 Trans Am has a brand new motor and its ready to be fired up for the first time. The Malicious Intent, a 1969 Mustang is ready for the paint shop. The 1972 Corvette. Ugly to beautiful restoration is in the stripping process.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The team at Muscle Cars of Texas will add primer to the frame of a half million dollar 1963 Corvette Z06. This 65 Mustang had a tune up and its ready for a test drive. A new costumer has dropped off a 1968 Corvette for a restoration project.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike’s 1939 Hudson Coupe-Convertible is the only survivor of three that were built. He wants Fantomworks to restore it to original condition – even though nobody knows what that looks like. Jim wants his 1970 Nova to be the ultimate dragster.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team are hard at work on the 1976 Trans Am. The 1972 Corvette is getting a custom paint job. The 66 Mustang needs a tune up.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: A 1917 Overland will be FantomWorks oldest restoration, if they can solve this jigsaw puzzle of rotted wood and rusted steel. Dan buys a 1968 Camaro on the internet for his wife, Malissa, and finds out that the car is in extremely poor condition.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: At FantomWorks, there are 85 cars being worked on and multiple owners who expect miracles. From a vintage motorcycle to getting a 1970 GTO ready for a returning vet, Dan burns the midnight oil to get cars out the door so new arrivals can take their place.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike thought his 1967 Chevy K10 Pick Up needed paint improvement. Dan quickly realizes that the car needs much more. Nobody restores 1970 Opel Kadett, so there are no parts anywhere for Harry’s car that needs a lot of everything.

programme.title: Snooker 900
programme.desc: Snooker 900 er den nye hurtige og spennende versjonen av spillet! Kom og se ukentlige konkurranser, arkiv spill, studio segmenter og mye mer.

programme.title: The Creator Clash
programme.desc: Jaack Maate and Joe Perry face Aaron Hunt and Tony Knowles in the Best of three frames.

programme.title: The Creator Clash
programme.desc: At the semi-final, Sara Guzo and Reanne Evans face Pieface23 and Dennis Taylor in the best of three frames.

programme.title: 900 Seconds with...

programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' ser Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood på konsekvensene ved å overse skilt i 'Skiltblind', lærer om merkelige ting som er 'Teknisk sett sant' og finner ut hvordan sprø ting blir 'Sprøere og sprøere'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' ser Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood syklister få seg en overraskelse i 'Uventede sykkelhinder', møter ondskapsfulle katter som viser 'Kattevrede' før de tar en titt på folk som setter hodet fast i 'Skallefeller'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' prøver Rob, Steelo og Kristy Sarah seg på 'Kostymekatastrofer', kommer i kontakt med 'Etikettefjerne folk' og blir vitner til 'Nære på-overganger'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood se folk som snus opp ned av 'Påtvungne overslag', får seg en drink og to for mye med 'Pussa bestemødre' og finner ut grunnen til å unngå dansing med drinker i 'Ikke drikk og dans'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' med Rob, Steelo og Kristy Sarah får vi se strålende treffsikkerhet i 'Skallesnikskyting', finner ut av hva som er motsatt av å prestere under press i 'Vanære under press' og avslutter med noen 'Sjalu hjerter'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' drar Rob, Steelo og gjestevert Lolo Wood for å skate med gjenstander på hjul som er 'Park-uforenlig', tar bilder og får seg en smell i 'Knipseattakk' og holder fast på verdisakene i møte med 'Mobile skurker'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' ser Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Lolo Wood hvor ekstrem bordtennis kan være i 'Pinpongvondt', blir kilt, rosa, svart og blå i en 'Kiletrøkk' og får justert ryggraden med noen 'Bakoverbøyere'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' kommer Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood farlig nær kanten i 'Uten kantfølelse', får bowlingvondt i 'Baneovertredelser' og trenger å slå av konsollen i 'Gamevrede'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' blir Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Lolo Wood sinte i helt feil situasjoner i 'Malplassert raseri', stikker av fra flaue opplevelser med 'Skamsortier' og blir helt uspiselige på flyplassen i 'Terminaltroll'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' får Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood besøk av bestselgende forfatter Greg McKeown og gjør vanskelige ting 'Uten anstrengelse' og mister oversikten over hva som er viktig i 'Absolutt ikke essensielt'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' opplever Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood smerte i vannparker i 'Vannparkskadet', møter par som elsker å gjøre stunt i 'Akropar' og ser på farene med fallende istapper i 'Risktapper'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I kveldens episode av 'Ridiculousness' sammenligner Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood arr på haka i 'Hakesmeller', får se at drikking skader mer enn kjøring i 'Styrtdumt' før de ser på noen ville hoppere som 'Hopper uten å sjekke'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness feirer Rob, Steelo og Brooke Schofield mannehjernene i 'Guttesmart, er sammen med unike hunder i 'Merkelige bisker' og får uventet en smell i knollen i 'Hode mot hode'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I denne episoden av 'Ridiculousness' braser Rob, Steelo og Brooke Schofield gjennom døra i 'Pinefulle hjemkomster', samler jentene og får oppleve 'Partyjentepine' og ser på problemer med nettingdører i 'Unger mot skjermer'.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Necklace
programme.desc: Matthew og Walter finner olje. Fallon ber om å få låne smykket Krystle pantsatte for å hjelpe Matthew. Steven og Claudia ligger med hverandre på hytta hans.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Beating
programme.desc: Steven kunngjør at han flytter ut av herskapshuset. Sjåføren, Michael, forteller Blake om Stevens forhold til Claudia. Fallon gjenopptar forholdet med Michael, inntil Blake får noen til å banke opp sjåføren.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Birthday Party
programme.desc: Blake finner ut at Krystle pantsatte smykket for å hjelpe Matthew. Fallon forteller Jeff at hun giftet seg med ham utelukkende for farens skyld. Stevens tidligere elsker, Ted, kommer til Denver.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Separation
programme.desc: Steven forteller Claudia at han tilbrakte natten med Ted. Krystle forlater Blake. Blake ser at Ted omfavner sønnen hans og angriper Ted. Steven anklager faren sin for mord.

programme.title: Dynasty: Blake Goes To Jail
programme.desc: Blake må i retten for mordet på Stevens elsker. Krystle kommer hjem for å være sammen med Blake. Fallon vitnet på vegne av faren, men Steven tilbakeviser påstandene hennes i retten.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Testimony
programme.desc: Blake hevder sin uskyld i retten. Matthew finner ut om Claudias forhold til Steven. Claudia og datteren, Lindsay, er innblandet i en bilulykke.

programme.title: Dynasty: Enter Alexis
programme.desc: Blakes første kone, Alexis, vitner og påstår at Blake kan være voldelig. Matthew stikker av sammen med Lindsay. Alexis forteller Steven at hun er glad i ham. Juryen kunngjør at de har nådd en avgjørelse.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Verdict
programme.desc: Blake blir funnet skyldig. Krystle gjenforenes med ektemannen. Blake slår Steven. Krystle er gravid og faller. Alexis flytter inn på Carrington-eiendommen.

programme.title: Dynasty: Alexis' Secret
programme.desc: Krystle beordrer Alexis om å forlate herskapshuset. Blake ber advokaten sin om å gjøre Steven arveløs. Claudia prøver å ta selvmord. Alexis forteller Steven at han er Blakes eneste barn.

programme.title: Dynasty: Fallon's Father
programme.desc: Alexis forteller Cecil Colby at Fallon er datteren hans. Blake og Steven oppfordres til å skvære opp. Dr. Toscanni trekker en bevisstløs Steven opp av bassenget og sender ham på sykehuset i all hast.

programme.title: Dynasty: Reconciliation
programme.desc: Steven vender tilbake til herskapshuset for å komme seg etter skadene han fikk da han falt. Krystles niese, Sammy Jo, kommer for å tilbringe noen uker hos Carrigton-familien.

programme.title: Dynasty: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: Nick forteller søsteren sin at Blake har skylden for at broren deres døde. Sammy Jo og Steven tilbringer natten sammen. Alexis skyter på Krystles hest.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Miscarriage
programme.desc: Krystle mister babyen. Steven og Sammy Jo begynner å date, selv om Steven er forelsket i Claudia. Fallon fortsetter forholdet med Nick, og blir sjalu når hun oppdager at han besøker Krystle på sykehuset.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Mid-East Meeting
programme.desc: Fallon finner ut at hun er gravid, og forteller Jeff at hun skal ta abort. Han går med på å skille seg, men bare hvis hun beholder barnet. Krystle sørger fortsatt over tapet av babyen.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Psychiatrist
programme.desc: Alexis lurer Blake til å komme til Roma og narrer ham i en felle ved å leie en snikfotograf til å ta suspekte bilder av dem. Jeff bønnfaller Fallon om å ikke ta abort.

programme.title: Dynasty: Sammy Jo and Steven Marry
programme.desc: Nick forteller Krystle at han elsker henne. Steven og Sammy Jo gifter seg. Fallon avlyser aborten. Etter skandalen forårsaket av paparazzibildene av Alexis og Blake, forlater Krystle Blake.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Car Explosion
programme.desc: Nick overtaler Krystle til å gå fra Blake. Steven og Sammy Jo kunngjør at de er gift. Blake angripes av gangstere og blir blindet når bilen hans bombes.

programme.title: Dynasty: Blake's Blindness
programme.desc: Blake er fortsatt blind etter eksplosjonen. Nick ber Krystle om å skille seg fra ektemannen og gifte seg med ham. Blake graver i Nicks fortid. Alexis er fast bestemt på å fordrive Krystle fra Denver.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
